dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in 2D width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentation on the right lateral margin at the transition to the peduncle; the left margin exhibits a slight convex bulge mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white with significant blue-spectrum reflectance across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of several thin, dark, linear contrast disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple healed linear rake marks visible on the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined, circular, dark-pixel aperture representing the blowhole at the anterior midline.
